notes: VCA331 REAL fix: form fields became uneditable (no keyboard caret) until the window was re-focused (open/close DevTools), after actions like Mark Unpaid. Root cause: native window.confirm() leaves the Electron renderer without keyboard focus on close (DevTools snippet showed document.hasFocus()=false, field enabled+on-top). Replaced ALL 6 native confirm() dialogs (Mark Unpaid, Discard draft, Delete location/seller/buyer, Knock-off suspense) with an in-app ConfirmModal (requestConfirm) — no native dialog, no focus loss. Explains the 'random freeze on different screens'. Supersedes the v0.1.201 blur-overlay attempt.
